correctness.rationale: The central symmetral Q has L(Q)=L(P) and A(P)+2|Wigner(P)|=A(Q) under correct oriented half-cycle Wigner area. Support-line edge lengths and shoelace area reduce the deficit exactly to 16n/(1+cos(pi/n)) times E(v), E=<v,Tv>. For mean-zero n-periodic v, T has positive eigenvalues cos(pi/n)-cos(2pi k/n). Explicit mean-zero g solves Tg=e0-1/n and E(g)=1/[n(1-cos(pi/n))], so energy Cauchy gives the sharp evaluation constant and all nontrivial equality vectors. Small nonzero t preserves all facets, yielding actual convex equality examples. Independently checked recurrence and exact energy through n=100; no claim finite n proves universal statement.
